༄༅/slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i rgyal mdos bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i rgyal mdos bzhugs so//

slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// mdos bshoms ni/ ri rab bang rim gsum brtsegs steng du kong bu lnga bkod/ de steng du gtor ma lnga/ de'i steng du bya dkar lding ba/ 'khor lha srin sde brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sde brgyad yongs rdzogs/ sman leb/ gling bzhi ngar mi/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gtor ma/ mar me ting lo spyan gzigs gzugs 'gros dar sna tshogs gos sna changs bu mtheb kyu sha khrag gis brgyan pa/ chang phud sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i snying po bzlas la/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs/ sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis sbyangs la/ bhrāt+s+mum̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ri rab mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa/ nam mkha' las dpangs mtho ba/ sa gzhi las rgya che ba/ ri bo las brjid che ba/ rtsi shing las grangs mang ba/ gur gum las dri zhim pa/ rgya mtsho las gting zab pa/ chu bo las rgyun ring bar gyur/ de nas 'di skad do/ kyai/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// dgung sngon mthon po'i yang steng na// rgyal po'i sku gcig bzhugs pa la// rgyal po yab dang yum gyi mtshan// yab ni shel gyi bskyed pa'i yab// yum ni sa bdag padma 'dren// de gnyis srid cing sprul pa las// chos skyong rgyal po dpe ha ra// skyes bu rgyal po chen po 'di// dang po gnam gyi steng du byon// gnam lha dkar po zhes su grags// bar du hor gyi yul du byon// sgom grwa chen po'i srung ma mdzad// srog bdag rgyal po zhes su grags// 'jig rten gnas na mthu bo che// sprul pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyed// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis// de nas bskal pa tha ma la// g.yo ru dpal gyis sa mtshams su// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang*// btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis// bsam yas dpal gyi chos 'khor bzhengs// de la sgo bsrung med pa las// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis// sprul pa'i dmag tshogs bsags nas su// bhe ta hor gyi yul du byon// khros pa'i tshul gyis sgom grwa bcom// mchod cha'i phyi la 'brengs nas su// dpe har rgyal po chen po khyod// bod la spyan 'dren 'gro dgos gsungs// de skad tsam zhig gsungs pa dang*// rgyal po chen po'i zhal na re// nga ni bod la mi 'gro'o// cis kyang bod la 'gro dgos na// steng du lha gcig dgos lags so// 'og tu klu gcig dgos lags so// slad kyi rjes nyul dgos lags so// g.yas kyi ru 'dren dgos lags so// g.yon gyi ru 'dren dgos lags so// yid ches gdong gtad dgos lags so// bsam pa'i grogs shig dgos lags so// sku yi skyo bsangs dgos lags so// de skad tsam zhig zhus pa dang*// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis// dgos byed smug 'gyur bya ba de// steng gi lha ru khrid nas byon// smug ri bu mo bya ba de// 'og gi klu ru khrid nas byon// sngags pa nag po phur thogs de// slad kyi rjes nyul khrid nas byon// g.yas ru shangs kyi btsan rgod de// g.yas kyi ru 'dren khrid nas byon// ratna gdong gi btsan rgod de// g.yon gyi ru 'dren khrid nas byon// gnas brtan chang kun bya ba de// yid ches gdong gtad khrid nas byon// na chung mdzes ma bya ba de// bsam pa'i grogs su khrid nas byon// de nas pho lha 'gro dgos gsungs// hor gyi yul nas spyan drangs te// rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas rnams// la brgya tsam zhig brgal nas byon// lung brgya tsam zhig brgal nas byon// chu brgya tsam zhig sgrol nas byon// chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam yas slebs// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis// bka' dang dam la btags nas su// chos 'khor chen po'i srung mar bskos// dgra lha chen por ming yang btags// dkor bdag chen por mnga' yang gsol// skyes mchog rgyal po chen po khyod// sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phro// dbu la snyung zhwa dar nag 'thibs// phyag g.yas spu gri 'bar ba bsnams// g.yon pa bdud kyi zhags pa 'dzin// sku la dom gyi slog pa gsol// chibs su ba glang sna ring bcibs// zab yangs gling du byon pa'i tshe// phyi bskor thengs gsum dwangs re spro// bar bskor thengs gsum nyams re dga'// nang bskor thengs gsum ltad mo che// dbu rtse rigs gsum byon pa'i tshe// btsan po rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// stag gzig gung gsum rten du 'dzugs// gser khang gling du byon pa'i tshe// rab byung rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// chos gos mkhar bsil rten du 'dzugs// bdud 'dul gling du byon pa'i tshe// sngags pa rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// dpal gyi phur bu rten du 'dzugs// sgra bsgyur gling du byon pa'i tshe// lo paṇa rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// glegs bam po ti rten du 'dzugs// yaksha steng 'og byon pa'i tshe// bon po rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// sha phud chang phud rten du 'dzugs// khams gsum gling du byon pa'i tshe// skyes pa rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// mda' dar rgod sgro rten du 'dzugs// byams pa gling du byon pa'i tshe// bud med rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// dngul dkar me long rten du 'dzugs// sde brgyad gling du byon pa'i tshe// stag shar rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// 'khor gsum srid pa rten du 'dzugs// mchod rten dkar por byon pa'i tshe// byis pa rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// yungs dkar rgyal po'i rten du 'dzugs// mchod rten dmar por byon pa'i tshe// sman pa rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// sman sna dri bzang rten du 'dzugs// mchod rten nag por byon pa'i tshe// mthu ba rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// sha sna snying sna rten du 'dzugs// mchod rten sngon por byon pa'i tshe// na chung rnams la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// nor rdzas sna dgu rten du 'dzugs// mchod rten khra bor byon pa'i tshe// sdang ba'i dgra rnams ma gtogs pa'i// sems can yongs la mi gnod pa'i// khas blangs dam bca' de ru mdzad// sdang ba'i dgra la cho 'phrul ston// dgos byed smug gyur bya ba de// lha dmag 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// lha rnams thams cad bdud du 'bebs// dmu rigs bu mo bya ba de// klu dmag 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// klu nad mdze shu gnyan rnams gtong*// g.yas su shangs kyi btsan rgod de// skyes pa stag chas brgya yis bskor// mda' 'phen de ni sha ra ra// gzhu sgra de ni sgrengs se sgreng*// ratna gdong gi btsan rgod de// dge slong dgra bcom brgya yis bskor// stag ral stag gdong khro lo lo// sngags pa nag po phur thogs de// ban dhe nag po brgya yis bskor// ngan sngags dmod mo di ri ri// na chung mdzes ma bya ba de// bud med nag mo brgya yis bskor// g.yab dar de ni lings se ling*// gnas brtan chang kun bya ba de// spre'u 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// rgyal po'i smyo 'bog snying 'jug gtong*// gar mkhan spun drug bya ba de// ma mo 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// ma mo'i dal yams sna tshogs gtong*// khyod ni mi brdzu dgu ru brdzus// mi sprul de ni dgu ru sprul// re 'ga' dge slong btsun par sprul// re 'ga' ban dhe sngags par sprul// re 'ga' lcags kyi spyang khur sprul// re 'ga' spre'u zhum bur sprul// bu chung khyi dang byi lar sprul// lha khang 'bag dang seng ger sprul// chags ni gser dang g.yu la chags// gnas ni lha khang dag na gnas// skyes pa pho yi srog la 'jab// za ma mo yi srid la rku// byis pa chung gi dbugs kyang len// 'grul phyir 'brengs nas gnod par byed// rgyal po 'khor bcas thams cad ni// sngon tshe padma'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bca' de ltar mdzod// de 'dra'i dam las ma 'da' bar// 'dir byon mdos dang gtor ma bzhes// glud dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs 'bul// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di// mnan pa theg la sdam pa glod// bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// yongs su chud la bde bar mdzod// de nas mdos kha phyir bsgyur nas 'di skad do/

kyai/ da ni rgyal po gdan bskyod do// de ni blon po dgra la rbad// rgyal po gshegs so sha ra ra// blon po bzhud do si li li// rgyal po rang gi rta la gshegs// rgyal po rang gi gnas su gshegs// 'di ru bzhugs pa'i gnas med pa// rwa chung 'di ru mi shong ngo*// 'bangs dang 'grogs na dri mi zhim// 'di ru dgyes pa'i grogs kyang med// 'di na mdzo shong ra mi shong*// 'di ru rta shong sga mi shong*// 'di ru dpon shong g.yog mi shong*// khyed rgyal po'i rigs su gyur pa rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rgyal po khyod la rdzongs 'debs so// so so'i gnas dang rten la gshegs// khyed rgyal po 'khor bcas thams cad kyis// chos 'khor dpal gyi lha khang dang*// g.yas ru gtsang 'gram lha khang dang*// g.yon ru khra 'brug lha khang dang*// dbus ru bka' stsal lha khang dang*// kong po bu chu'i lha khang dang*// gtsang 'brug rgyal gyi lha khang dang*// bum thang dge bsnyen lha khang dang*// byang shar sbrang rtsi'i lha khang dang*// bal yul 'phags pa shing kun dang*// lha khang so so'i gnas su gshegs// rgyal po'i bzhugs sa de na yod// btsun mo'i chos bzang de na yod// 'bangs dang 'khor g.yog de na yod// gser dngul zangs lcags de na yod// khrab rmog gri gsum de na yod// bya khyi phag gsum de na yod// gnag rta lug gsum de na yod// ja dang gos dar de na yod// rgyal po longs spyod de na che// rgyal po 'khor bcas de ru gshegs// rgyal po bzhugs pa'i longs spyod med// rgyal po bzhugs pa'i dkor yang med// 'di ru bzhugs pa'i gnas med do// da lta nyid du gshegs su gsol// steng lha'i rgyal po gshegs su gsol// 'og klu'i rgyal po gshegs su gsol// bar mi'i rgyal po gshegs su gsol// g.yas ru gtsang 'gram rgyal po gshegs su gsol// g.yon ru khra 'brug rgyal po gshegs su gsol// dbus ru bka' stsal rgyal po gshegs su gsol// srog bdag srid pa'i rgyal po gshegs su gsol// ming dang mtshan ni ma thos pa'i// rgyal po'i rigs gyur thams cad gshegs// glud dang mdos gtor 'di bzhes la// rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di// mnan pa theg la bsdams pa lhod// bzung ba thongs la bcings pa bkrol// yongs su chud la bde bar mdzod// phyin chad gnod pa ma mdzad cig

/zhi ba'i ngang las gshegs su gsol// legs dang sprod la nyes dang bsnol// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// sngon tshe slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bca' mdzad pa bzhin// gsang sngags chos 'khor sgrub pa'i gang zag la// bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus ster ba yi// chos skyong rgyal po chen po khyed rnams kyis// bdag sogs bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod// ma hā rā dza gatstsha/ zhes brjod nas yon tan mthong zhing mar me btsugs// phyogs skyong rgyal po bzhugs pa'i phyogs su bskyal lo// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa siddhi pha la ho/// /
